avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces darolutamide plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; counsel patient to discontinue prior to darolutamide therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Saw Palmetto
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May have additive androgen-blocking effects; risk of enhanced pharmacodynamic effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; monitor for increased adverse effects (fatigue, sexual dysfunction)

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase darolutamide exposure
caution_supplements.action: Inform patient to avoid high-dose or frequent grapefruit products; monitor efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Possible mild CYP3A4 induction; minimal clinical impact expected
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for any changes in darolutamide efficacy

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases darolutamide bioavailability and systemic exposure; risk of toxicity
avoid_foods.action: Advise patient to avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice entirely during treatment

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase darolutamide absorption; variable food effect reported
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient on consistent meal timing; can be taken with or without food, but maintain consistency

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum PSA levels, testosterone, and clinical response regularly. Assess for signs of darolutamide toxicity (rash, hepatotoxicity) if CYP3A4 inhibitors are inadvertently used; baseline liver function tests recommended.
